fields.title: Gas service assumptions
fields.finding: Leakage, scarf permeability, 90% conditioning and connected core pores are projected. The 24h pressure/inventory calculation is a conditional bound on sampled geometries, not a sealed-life result or a measured temperature law.
fields.missing_evidence: Whole-hull leaks, pore venting, desorption and permeability versus temperature.
